title: a torn host tree in tools/host_tree.pack (reproduced locally; not the cause of the box-run build-case failures in CI)

findings.claim: tools/host_tree.pack read each file twice (hash, then tar): a file that changed in between gave a host tree that did not match its own HOST-SHA256SUMS, and verify_update.py refused the signed bundle at b06 (reproduced locally with a concurrent writer; make_bundle.sh packs with the same function, so a tree edited during a vendor's pack fails closed on every box); pack now hashes while copying into a snapshot and tars the snapshot. It was not the cause of the rehearsal's build-case failures on trains 99 and 100: those came only on runs carrying lane K's update-from-a-stick card (#1177, #1202)
